title: Region: the Red Canyon
prompt: An isometric bird's-eye view, like a big open level of Minecraft Dungeons seen from the game's high three-quarter camera, every part built from chunky blocks with hand-painted pixel textures, a few small blocky heroes (Percy in his orange camp shirt, Annabeth, Grover) for scale, monsters about, a glowing marble-and-gold waystone pillar somewhere on a path. The Red Canyon in hot afternoon light, a desert that has no business being on Long Island, monster level 5 to 7: flat-topped red mesas, a dry river wash, slot canyons, cactus and bones, a ghost town (a saloon, a water tower, a general store), the Garden of Stone (people turned to grey statues among broken columns), a giant scorpion's den in a cave under a mesa, a camp of silver tents of the Hunters of Artemis on a mesa top, a stone shrine to Apollo with a golden sun disc, and a huge crimson scorpion with a golden stinger (the region's champion). 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
